_doc: Mission file (openspec/changes/mission-scripting; the format is docs/design/mission-files.md). Edit with tools/mission-editor or by hand.
name: Capture the prize
objective: Board and take the {prize_name}, whole. Needs marines.
brief: Research wants a {name(fac)} {cls} to take apart, and the {prize_name} is passing through this sector under escort. Strip her shields, beat her down until she strikes, board her and tow her home to {home}. She is worth nothing to us destroyed: sink her and the contract is void.

objectives.text: Board and take the {prize_name} (not destroy her)
Take her with more than a sixth of her hull

result.log: The {prize_name} is under tow. Bring her home to the research yard.
The {prize_name} got away{crushing ? ', and the fleet with it barely did' : ''}.
